The Early Bird Discount has no calendar date: it is granted only if the tuition fee is paid within three weeks of the admission results being published (2027 result dates and the tuition payment deadline are listed as TBA). Bachelor's rolling admission for International Business Management runs 1 October 2026 - 25 February 2027, with the study place to be confirmed within three weeks of the decision.
official.application_cycle: Autumn 2026 and spring 2027 admission rounds for studies beginning in the 2027-2028 academic year
official.status_note: Rolling admission for the Bachelor's Programme in International Business Management is open 1 October 2026 - 25 February 2027 for autumn 2027 entry; the joint application to all international Bachelor's and Master's programmes runs 7-21 January 2027. The university notes the application schedule may be updated on its webpages during autumn 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording: "The tuition fee covers the costs of tuition but does not include living expenses such as accommodation, meals, transportation or other personal costs." and "The University of Oulu does not offer scholarships that cover 100% of the tuition fee."
benefits: Early Bird Discount on the first-year tuition fee in selected degree programmes: 5% to 30% depending on the programme
Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship from the second year onwards in selected degree programmes: 5% to 40% of the annual tuition fee

Nokia Scholarships of 3,000 euros each, in a limited number, in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering master's programmes Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics, Wireless Communications Engineering and Sustainable and Autonomous Systems
eligibility: Admitted to an English-taught Bachelor's or Master's degree programme at the University of Oulu
Citizen of a country outside the EU/EEA or Switzerland and not holding a Finnish residence permit that exempts from tuition fees
Early Bird Discount: tuition fee paid within three weeks of the admission results being published

Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship: at least 60 ECTS credits completed during the preceding academic year in accordance with the approved study plan, including the required Finnish language studies (2-5 ECTS depending on the programme)
The University of Oulu scholarship can be received only once, to one degree programme
requirements: At least 60 ECTS of studies completed in accordance with the approved personal study plan, including the mandatory Finnish language studies (2-5 ECTS depending on the study programme)

New students must pay the full first-year tuition fee in a single payment by the deadline; tuition fees are paid through the Flywire payment platform and cannot be paid in instalments in the first year

Bachelor's applicants need an upper secondary qualification giving eligibility for university-level studies; Master's applicants need a first academic degree, normally a Bachelor's degree of at least three years of full-time studies (180 ECTS)

Applicants completing their qualification in spring or summer 2027 must graduate and submit final documents by the published deadline (graduation by 13 July 2027 for Bachelor's, by 30 July 2027 for Master's applicants)
documents: No separate scholarship application or supporting documents for the Early Bird Discount - the discount is granted by paying the tuition fee within three weeks of the admission results being published
No separate application for the Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship - faculty study services check the student's credits and the waiver is applied to the annual fee

For continuation of a scholarship after a year short of the minimum credits: a medical certificate, the child's birth certificate or a KELA certificate, or a statement from the degree programme director for the documented cases; force majeure situations are assessed separately

Study-application file needed to become a fee-liable student: diploma and transcript of records (or the latest transcript of records if graduating in spring 2027), official translations where documents are not in English, Finnish or Swedish, proof of English language proficiency, and programme-specific attachments such as a pre-assignment or essay for master's applications
selection_criteria: Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarships are awarded based on successful progress in studies: at least 60 ECTS credits in the preceding academic year in accordance with the approved study plan, including the required Finnish language studies
The Early Bird Discount is granted on the basis of payment timing, not academic merit

Nokia Scholarships go to a limited number of talented, accepted applicants in the four listed master's programmes and are intended for students fast progressing in System-on-Chip and Radio Frequency related courses
coverage: Early Bird Discount: 5% to 30% of the first-year tuition fee depending on the degree programme (for example a 10,000 EUR annual fee reduced to 7,000 EUR at 30%)

Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship: 5% to 40% of the annual tuition fee from the second year onwards (for example Architecture at 14,000 EUR reduced to 8,400 EUR at 40%, or Environmental Engineering at 10,000 EUR reduced to 6,000 EUR at 40%)
Published annual tuition fees range from 8,500 EUR to 14,000 EUR depending on the programme
The tuition fee covers the costs of tuition but does not include living expenses such as accommodation, meals, transportation or other personal costs
application_method: Apply for the degree programme through the Finnish joint application system at studyinfo.fi (joint application 7-21 January 2027; rolling admission 1 October 2026 - 25 February 2027 for the Bachelor's Programme in International Business Management)
Early Bird Discount: no separate scholarship application - pay the tuition fee through the Flywire payment platform within three weeks of the admission results being published
Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship: no separate application - faculty study services verify the completed credits and apply the waiver
Nokia Scholarship: separate application for admitted applicants in the four specified ITEE master's programmes; further information to be published by the university
official.application_route: Studyinfo.fi joint application (7-21 January 2027) or rolling admission for International Business Management; the discount and waiver themselves need no application form.
official.study_mode: Full-time degree programmes: Bachelor's programmes 3+2 years and Master's programmes 2 years, as published on the International Programmes page
official.citizenship_residency: Tuition fee liability applies to citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA or Switzerland admitted to English-taught Bachelor's and Master's programmes without an exempting residence permit; exemptions cover EU/EEA/Swiss citizens, permanent (P) and long-term resident EU (P-EU) permits, residence based on temporary protection, an EU Blue Card in Finland, right of residence under the withdrawal agreement, and certain continuous (A) permits.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - both the Early Bird Discount and the Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship are aimed at fee-paying non-EU/EEA international students; EU/EEA and Swiss citizens pay no tuition fee and fall outside this scheme.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Early Bird Discounts and Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarships are available only in selected degree programmes - the programme-specific tables on the official page list the exact percentage; Epidemiology and Biomedical Data Science lists neither. The separate Nokia Scholarship is restricted to four ITEE master's programmes.
official.duration: Bachelor's degree programmes 3+2 years; Master's degree programmes 2 years
official.description: The University of Oulu charges tuition fees from non-EU/EEA students admitted to English-taught Bachelor's and Master's degree programmes; the fee covers tuition but not living expenses. Selected programmes grant an Early Bird Discount if the tuition fee is paid within three weeks of the admission results being published, and Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarships of 5% to 40% are available from the second year onwards to continuing students who complete at least 60 ECTS credits in the preceding academic year in line with their approved study plan, including the required Finnish language studies. The university states it does not offer scholarships covering 100% of the tuition fee.
official.program_type: Programme-specific Early Bird tuition discount and progress-based tuition fee waiver for international fee-paying students
official.english_requirement: Master's programmes: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 5.5 per section, TOEFL iBT 92 with 20 in Writing (or 4.5 overall with 4 in Writing on the banded scale used for tests taken from 21 January 2026), PTE Academic 62 with 52 in Writing, Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency grade A-C, YKI skill level 5, or an accepted prior degree/qualification completed in English. Bachelor's programmes: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with 5.5 per section, TOEFL iBT 78 (or 4.0 overall with 3.5 per section on the new scale), PTE Academic 62 with 61 in writing, Cambridge C1/C2, YKI level 4, or an accepted prior qualification; SAT minimum 1050 with 480 in reading/writing or ACT 20 are used in bachelor's selection.

applicant_utility.summary: This is not a scholarship you apply for: the Early Bird Discount is a 5-30% cut on the first-year tuition that only materialises if you pay the full fee through Flywire within three weeks of the admission results, while the Tuition Fee Waiver (5-40% from year two) is granted automatically once you have completed 60 ECTS in line with your approved study plan, including the mandatory Finnish language studies. Nothing here touches living costs - Oulu explicitly has no 100% tuition scholarship - so you must fund the remaining annual fee (the published post-discount figures run from 6,000 to about 10,200 EUR) plus accommodation, food and transport. Check your exact programme's percentage before accepting, because otherwise similar programmes differ by up to 30 percentage points, and one listed programme offers neither discount nor waiver.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Fee-paying non-EU/EEA applicants who can front the whole first-year tuition in one payment within three weeks of the results and can keep a steady 60-ECTS-per-year pace, Finnish studies included.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply through studyinfo.fi in the joint window (7-21 January 2027), or via rolling admission (1 October 2026 - 25 February 2027) if you are targeting the Bachelor's in International Business Management.
Before accepting any offer, read your programme's row in the fee/scholarship tables and note both the fee after the Early Bird discount and the year-two waiver percentage.
Line up the money before results day: the first-year fee must be paid in a single Flywire payment and the discount expires three weeks after results are published.
Book your English test early - the result must be valid for at least one day during the application period, only scanned final results are accepted, and only final documents, never screenshots.
Plan your first year around 60 ECTS including the compulsory Finnish language studies (2-5 ECTS depending on programme) and agree a study plan that matches that pace.
If you graduate in spring/summer 2027, diarise the final-document deadline (13 July 2027 for Bachelor's, 30 July 2027 for Master's) so your conditional admission does not lapse.
common_rejection_risks: Missing the three-week Early Bird payment window - there is no late application and no retroactive discount.
Dropping below 60 ECTS in a year (Finnish language studies included), which switches the next year back to the full tuition fee unless you win a documented continuation.
Assuming every programme has the discount: Epidemiology and Biomedical Data Science lists neither an Early Bird discount nor a waiver.
Waiting for a scholarship decision letter - the Early Bird is triggered by payment, not by an award, and the waiver is granted with no application at all.
Budgeting as if the waiver were full funding and failing to show the remaining 60-95% of the fee plus living costs.
Letting the English proof lapse: the test must still be valid during the application period and forged or preliminary results cause automatic rejection.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living expenses (accommodation, meals, transport and personal costs, which the fee explicitly excludes), the 60-95% of tuition left after the discount or waiver, resident-permit and insurance costs, and travel/installation - none of which the discount or waiver covers.
document_audit: The discount itself requires no documents; the real traps sit in the admission file - scanned final test results only, official translations stamped or signed by an authorised translator, and verified final diploma and transcript by the stated deadline.
Claiming English proficiency from previous education needs the language of instruction stated on the certificate or transcript; a document merely issued in English is not accepted as proof.
Master's applications also need programme-specific attachments such as a pre-assignment or essay, listed in the Studyinfo portal - missing these weakens or voids the assessment.
A temporary (provisional) degree certificate is only accepted if awarded within the last five years and not expired before the application deadline.
alerts: Year one requires the full fee in one payment with no instalment option, so the Early Bird decision forces an immediate cash commitment before you have started studying.
Earning any study credits during the year - even remotely - removes the tuition refund possibility even if you never travel to Finland.
The scholarship scheme was changed for the 2026 intake; older 50-70% scholarship descriptions you may find online refer to pre-2025 admits and no longer apply.
The Oulu scholarship can be received only once and only for one degree programme, and it cannot be transferred to another programme later.

Nokia Scholarships (3,000 EUR each) exist only in four ITEE master's programmes and their application details were still unpublished when this was verified - treat them as a possible bonus, not a plan.
The university warns the 2027 application schedule may change during autumn 2026, so re-check the deadlines page before the January window.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Studyinfo application in the January joint round (or rolling admission for International Business Management), then no scholarship forms at all - pay via Flywire within three weeks of results to lock in the Early Bird, and let faculty study services award the waiver at the end of each academic year based on your 60 ECTS.
